people.name: Abimelech
people.line: Philistine king who interacted with Abraham and Isaac

people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

translations.web: Abraham took sheep and cattle, and gave them to Abimelech. Those two made a covenant.
translations.bsb: So Abraham brought sheep and cattle and gave them to Abimelech, and the two men made a covenant.
translations.kjv: And Abraham took sheep and oxen, and gave them unto Abimelech; and both of them made a covenant.
translations.asv: And Abraham took sheep and oxen, and gave them unto Abimelech. And they two made a covenant.
